AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to Simulated Flying, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Simulated Flying.

2. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.

8. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

12. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.

13. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

14. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
